exposure: Caesarean section (CS) due to labor dystocia
cohort: The study involved 120 nulliparous women at >= 38 weeks of gestation who presented to the antenatal clinic but were not in labor.
finding: A narrow angle of progression (AOP) (< 96 degrees) and occiput-posterior fetal position are associated with a higher risk of Caesarean section due to labor dystocia.
mod_finding: A narrow AOP (< 96 degrees) is associated with increased risk of Cesarean section.
